targets.title: Channel-capacity, intelligibility and immediate memory.
targets.evidence_quote: In the current study, we replicated the methods of Rabbitt (1968) Experiment 2 to test whether noise impairs recall of previously heard items.
targets.outcome_quote: In this study, we attempted to replicate Rabbitt (1968) in a large online sample using the original method of absolute scoring as well as a partial scoring method. The results robustly support Rabbitt’s main finding: the presence of noise disrupts recall of previously heard information.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Primary replication finding supported across scoring and analyses. Failed interaction was an explicitly novel extension, not an originally tested finding.
